mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reading_history (user_id, novel_id, chapter_id, chapter_no, progress) VALUES (#{userId}, #{novelId}, #{chapterId}, #{chapterNo}, #{progress}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE chapter_id = VALUES(chapter_id), chapter_no = VALUES(chapter_no), progress = VALUES(progress), last_read_time = NOW()
mapper.select:
SELECT h.id, h.novel_id, h.chapter_id, h.chapter_no, h.progress, h.last_read_time, n.title, n.author, n.cover_url, n.chapter_count AS total_chapter, c.name AS category_name, n.tags AS tags, ch.title AS chapter_title,
(SELECT MIN(c2.chapter_no) FROM chapter c2 WHERE c2.novel_id = n.id AND c2.chapter_no > h.chapter_no) AS next_chapter_no FROM reading_history h JOIN novel n ON n.id = h.novel_id AND n.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = n.category_id LEFT JOIN chapter ch ON ch.id = h.chapter_id WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY h.last_read_time DESC
